steadyHeat.explanation: Evaluate temperature and heat loss through a layered wall with volumetric heat and prescribed temperature, outward heat flux or convection ends.
pitfalls: Generates a bounded line finite element mesh and scalar diffusion weak formulation.
Native node field and element-midpoint flux are checked against independent piecewise-quadratic exact conduction and global/interface source conservation.
Optional sampled field/flux limits block unmet results; generated inputs and explicit losses remain inspectable.

examples.purpose: Evaluate temperature and heat loss through a layered wall with volumetric heat and prescribed temperature, outward heat flux or convection ends.

steadyCurrent.explanation: Evaluate potential and current through layered DC resistors with fixed potential or outward current density ends.
pitfalls: Generates a bounded line finite element mesh and scalar diffusion weak formulation.
Native node field and element-midpoint flux are checked against independent piecewise-quadratic exact conduction and global/interface source conservation.
Optional sampled field/flux limits block unmet results; generated inputs and explicit losses remain inspectable.

examples.purpose: Evaluate potential and current through layered DC resistors with fixed potential or outward current density ends.

fields.explanation: A steady layered thermal or electrical conduction document. Layers, sources and ends specify the physical problem; native field/flux and exact conservation checks determine success. All layer/end values use the units for the selected operation.

/properties/version.explanation: The fixed authored input contract schemaxis.getdp/1; this is separate from the external GetDP runtime version 3.5.0. Always retain this literal.

/properties/operation.explanation: Choose steadyHeat for temperature and heat flux, or steadyCurrent for DC potential and current density. Both share layer records but their conductivity/source/field units differ; there is no Joule-heating coupling.

/properties/layers.explanation: One to sixteen material layers ordered from left x=0 toward right. Interfaces share nodes and enforce perfect contact with continuous field and flux; no contact resistance or imported mesh. Total cells may not exceed 512.

/properties/layers/items.explanation: A constant-property layer. Thickness and conductivity control resistance; uniform source controls the flux gradient. Optional cells default to 16 and source to zero; names must be unique.

/properties/layers/items/properties/name.explanation: Unique descriptive layer name, 1–48 characters. It identifies material intent in the summary; native labels are generated integers, so names are never executable GetDP source.

/properties/layers/items/properties/thic.explanation: Positive layer thickness in metres (1e-5 to 1000). It extends the x coordinate and contributes thickness/conductivity to resistance per area; required, with no inferred thickness.

/properties/layers/items/properties/cond.explanation: Required positive thermal conductivity in W/(m K) for heat or electrical conductivity in S/m for current (1e-5 to 1e8). Constant within this layer. Conductivity/element-length contrast across layers must not exceed 1e8.

/properties/layers/items/properties/sour.explanation: Uniform volumetric generation: W/m3 for heat or A/m3 distributed current injection for current. Defaults to zero; negative values remove heat/current. This is not automatic Joule heating. Magnitude is bounded at 1e8.

/properties/layers/items/properties/cell.explanation: Two to 128 equal line cells within this layer; defaults to 16. Mesh-node fields and midpoint flux are published, so place enough cells to sample an intended source-driven extremum; internal continuum peaks are not certified by limits.

/properties/left.explanation: Boundary at x=0. Positive outward flux points toward negative x, so negative flux injects heat/current. Choose fixed value, outward flux or thermal convection. No default end condition is inserted.

/properties/left/properties/kind.explanation: Select value, flux or convection. value/flux requires only a numeric value; convection requires only positive coefficient and ambient and is thermal only. Two flux ends are unanchored and refused.

/properties/left/properties/value.explanation: For kind=value, fixed temperature in nonnegative K or electrical potential in V. For kind=flux, signed outward heat flux W/m2 or current density A/m2. Zero flux is insulation; negative flux injects. Required for these two kinds and forbidden for convection.

/properties/left/properties/coefficient.explanation: Positive thermal convection coefficient in W/(m2 K), from 1e-6 to 1e8. Convection outflow is coefficient times (surface temperature minus ambient). Required only for convection; electrical operation does not support it.

/properties/left/properties/ambient.explanation: Nonnegative thermal ambient temperature in kelvin. Required for convection; no Celsius conversion or radiation is implied. Do not provide it for fixed-value or flux ends.

/properties/right.explanation: Boundary at total thickness. Positive outward flux points toward positive x. Choose fixed value, outward flux or thermal convection. At least one end must fix a value or use thermal convection.

/properties/right/properties/kind.explanation: Select value, flux or convection. value/flux requires only a numeric value; convection requires only positive coefficient and ambient and is thermal only. Two flux ends are unanchored and refused.

/properties/right/properties/value.explanation: For kind=value, fixed temperature in nonnegative K or electrical potential in V. For kind=flux, signed outward heat flux W/m2 or current density A/m2. Zero flux is insulation; negative flux injects. Required for these two kinds and forbidden for convection.

/properties/right/properties/coefficient.explanation: Positive thermal convection coefficient in W/(m2 K), from 1e-6 to 1e8. Convection outflow is coefficient times (surface temperature minus ambient). Required only for convection; electrical operation does not support it.

/properties/right/properties/ambient.explanation: Nonnegative thermal ambient temperature in kelvin. Required for convection; no Celsius conversion or radiation is implied. Do not provide it for fixed-value or flux ends.

/properties/area_m2.explanation: Constant cross-sectional area in m2, default 1, bounded 1e-8 to 1e6. It scales integrated end power/current and generation; temperature/potential and flux density are unchanged. Variable area is excluded.

/properties/limits.explanation: Optional sampled acceptance bounds; omitted or empty means physics verification only. Bounds compare actual native mesh-node field and element-midpoint flux. They do not certify unsampled continuum extrema or all tolerance variants; unmet limits fail with retained margins.

/properties/limits/properties/minimumFie.explanation: Minimum acceptable native mesh-node temperature in K or potential in V. Every node must meet this lower bound. Omission disables this bound; if maximumField exists the lower bound must not exceed it.

/properties/limits/properties/maximumFie.explanation: Maximum acceptable native mesh-node temperature in K or potential in V. Every node must meet this upper bound. Omission disables this bound. A source-driven peak between nodes is outside this sampled promise.

/properties/limits/properties/maxAbsFlux.explanation: Nonnegative upper bound for absolute native element-midpoint heat flux W/m2 or current density A/m2. Omission disables this bound. Source-corrected boundary flux can differ from a midpoint value and is reported separately.
